metadata.title: A sharp plank theorem for cube annuli
metadata.abstract: We prove a conjecture of András Bezdek on plank coverings of square annuli. A plank in a Euclidean space is the closed region between two distinct parallel hyperplanes, and its width is the distance between them. Let $Q$ be a unit square and let $H$ be a square of side length $1/2$ whose sides are parallel to those of $Q$. Then every finite family of planks covering $Q\setminus H$ has total width at least $1$. More generally, if an axis-parallel box with side lengths $h_1,\ldots,h_d$ is removed from the unit cube in $\mathbb{R}^d$ and $\sum_jh_j = d-1$, then every finite plank covering of the remaining set has total width at least one. The bounds are sharp.

analysis.progressType: 带孔立方体的尖锐plank覆盖
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明单位正方形去掉边平行、边长1/2的正方形后，任何有限plank覆盖总宽度至少1；更一般，单位d立方体去掉边长h₁,…,h_d的轴平行盒，若总和为d−1，则余集有限plank覆盖总宽度至少1。界可达到。
analysis.breakthrough: 解决Bezdek的正方形环覆盖猜想，并推广到具有精确边长和条件的高维盒孔。
analysis.limitations: 孔的轴平行和边长和条件必须保留；plank本身可斜置，但不能据此推出任意形状孔或任意体积约束有同一界。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第6页明确把仿射变换后使用Bang引理的想法归于作者，而由ChatGPT实施。可标指定证明路线的推导完善，不能把作者先提出的核心策略归于模型，也没有披露软件编程。
